title: Calendar two-way sync has a working connect button for Google, Apple, Outlook and Notion

source.ref: Split from SCAN-1134, calendar redesign plan phase 12

detail: FILED 2026-10-26. THE CONSEQUENCE: the calendar settings list four sync providers, each with a Coming soon mark and no button, so a team can only subscribe to the one-way feed. Real two-way sync needs provider OAuth apps and credentials, token storage, a sync worker and conflict rules; the calendar plan holds it until the owner says go. Public and team feeds work today. See ADR-1876.

verify.note: Fails on main (every provider row is marked Coming soon), passes once a provider can be connected.
